result:
Primitive Education campaign abhi bhi **BLOCKED** hai. Is run mein koi kaam aage nahi barha.

- **Kya check kiya:** Lock lene ke baad chaaron held-out videos (xBJ6suQSt98, 6YHva7Me2ls, C_jSOXP_XWY, 5gSIU30yiVs) ki MP4 files ko 6 second ki limit ke saath padhne ki koshish ki. Chaaron files ka read abhi bhi atak jata hai. Ye files `~/Downloads/videos in mp3/PrimitiveEducation-MP4/` mein hain. Wajah shayad macOS ki privacy permission (TCC) hai, lekin ye sirf andaza hai, confirm nahi hua.
- **Koi aur copy nahi mili:** Downloads ke bahar in videos ki koi copy nahi hai, aur koi external drive bhi connected nahi hai.
- **Kya nahi hua:** Na prep chala, na koi reviewer, na ledger ya publication mein koi tabdeeli.
- **Usage:** five-hour 0.02, weekly 0.78.
- **Records:** `CONTINUATION_HANDOFF.md` aur `progress_log.txt` mein ye recheck likh diya hai. Lock release ho gaya hai. Agla wake epoch 1793899500 `next_wake_epoch` mein likh diya hai.

**Aap ko ye karna hoga (koi ek):**
1. Scheduler ki process chain (launchd → claude → python/ffmpeg) ko Downloads ya Full Disk Access ki permission dein.
2. Ya chaaron MP4 files Downloads se bahar kisi durable jagah copy karein, `videos/<id>/evidence/source_sha256.txt` se SHA-256 match karein, aur `source_path.txt` update kar dein.

Is ke baghair agla kaam (held-out videos, phir evaluation, phir reconstruction test) shuru nahi ho sakta. Listening ab bhi BLOCKED_CAPABILITY hai, aur koi CT_SCAN_COMPLETE ya FULL_AV_SIGNOFF nahi diya gaya.
